test_AIAgent_init_oauth_guard: test the AIAgent.__init__ constructor does not flip _is_anthropic_oauth for third-party providers like minimax
test_AIAgent_refresh_oauth_guard: test AIAgent._try_refresh_anthropic_client_credentials returns False and leaves _is_anthropic_oauth unchanged for third-party providers
test_AIAgent_swap_credential_oauth_guard: test AIAgent._swap_credential never flips _is_anthropic_oauth when rotating credentials for third-party providers
test_AIAgent_fallback_oauth_guard: test AIAgent._try_activate_fallback does not set _is_anthropic_oauth True when activating a third-party fallback provider
test_is_oauth_token: test the _is_oauth_token function returns False for API-key tokens and third-party key shapes like mxp-abcdef123
